verified_claims.claim: The production VLM physics gate detects 14/16 planted silent failures that solver-level checks miss.
verified_claims.evidence: The primary paper reports 14/16 overall. The controlled design uses four production-passed flow templates, four planted failure categories, and four clean controls, with the same single-shot production verifier.

verified_claims.claim: Per-category recall is 4/4 missing-deliverable, 4/4 wrong-magnitude, 4/4 broken-postprocessing, and 2/4 convergence-not-settled.
verified_claims.evidence: The paper's planted-failure table reports exactly these category counts. The released ablation driver constructs the matching 20-case design and implements post-hoc missing-output, impossible-magnitude contract, zeroed/degenerate postprocessing, and consistently truncated endTime perturbations.

verified_claims.claim: The planted-failure evidence supports an observability-matched multi-gate interpretation rather than a universal VLM verifier.
verified_claims.evidence: The convergence-not-settled category is only 2/4 because consistently edited endTime can make a truncated run appear visually complete. This directly demonstrates a failure class whose decisive evidence is temporal/numerical rather than reliably visible in rendered fields.

verified_claims.claim: The ablation's clean controls expose a false-positive calibration problem.
verified_claims.evidence: The primary appendix reports all four clean controls flagged REVISE, yielding TP=14, FP=4, FN=2, TN=0, precision 14/18=77.8%, recall 14/16=87.5%, F1=82.4%. The stated cause is mismatch between generic requirements mentioning deliverables and the reduced interpret-mode figure subset used by the ablation harness.

scope_corrections: Do not summarize 14/16 as a general physical-validity guarantee. It is recall on 16 constructed post-hoc failures across four CFD templates under one production verifier setup.

The clean-control result materially matters: high planted-failure recall coexists with 0/4 clean controls passing in the reduced harness, so precision/requirement-to-artifact alignment must be calibrated before using such a gate as a hard promotion controller.

The evidence supports routing failure classes to detectors at the modality where they become observable: field-level VLM checks are orthogonal to solver logs, but temporal convergence requires deterministic residual/QoI/end-time evidence.

This ablation does not by itself show that the proposed full detector stack improves end scientific quality relative to a matched simpler controller; it isolates sensitivity of the VLM gate to constructed failures.

reproducibility.design: 4 failure categories x 4 flow templates + 4 controls
